_note: Named task subsets for quota-limited runs. A subset is chosen from the pass rates of one model, so a baseline for comparisons must be re-run fresh on the subset (selection on the same runs biases it toward 50%).

g35-mid.why: pooled pass rates 0.50-0.75 over n>=3 runs (b08 3/4, b12 2/4, b13 2/4, b16 2/3); excluded: b02/b05/b09 (4/4, ceiling), b15 (0/4, floor), b19/b21/b23/b25/b26 (n=1, undecided)
